component.name: GNOME Theme Manager
component.summary: Modern GTK4 & Libadwaita theme, icon, cursor and shell manager for GNOME

description.p: GNOME Theme Manager is a modern desktop application for Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, and all GNOME-based Linux distributions. It allows users to discover, install, apply, and customize GTK4/3 themes, icon packs, cursor sets, and GNOME Shell themes seamlessly through a native Libadwaita user interface or a powerful CLI.

ul.li: Online Theme Store with direct Pling and OpenDesktop integration
GNOME Shell Extensions manager with real-time toggle switches
Scanning and management of user (~/.themes, ~/.icons, ~/.local/share) and system themes
One-click GTK4 and Libadwaita theme overrides via CSS symlinking
Archive theme installer supporting .tar.gz, .tar.xz, and .zip archives
Global Theme presets to save, restore, and share complete desktop theme configurations
Flatpak and Snap sandbox compatibility checks and automatic theme propagation
Native GNOME Libadwaita GUI and fast Command Line Interface (CLI)

screenshot.caption: Main Window of GNOME Theme Manager displaying active themes and preset management

description.p: Release 1.5.0: Flatpak distribution support with standalone bundle (.flatpak) and click-to-install (.flatpakref); integrated Online Theme Store for OpenDesktop and Pling with 1-click download and installation; full-screen high-definition screenshot viewer; and comprehensive GNOME Shell Extensions manager.

Release 1.4.8: Dynamic system and sandbox theme fallback discovery; 1-click Light/Dark color scheme preference selector across Status, Themes, and Editor; real-time live GSettings desktop synchronization; in-app interactive sandbox guide modal; and asynchronous diagnostics performance optimizations.

Release 1.4.1: Custom theme icon pickers; unified custom theme folder structure (GTK + Shell); improved Theme Editor state management with Open Theme dialog; and user theme deletion with active theme protections.

Release 1.4.0: Global Theme in-place editing; custom theme icon pickers; comprehensive Desktop Typography and text scaling controls; GNOME Terminal ANSI color derivation, preferences, and profile management.
Release 1.3.0: Resilient fallback themes system across Host, Flatpak, and Snap; optional User Themes extension auto-enablement; and bundled UI fallback icons.
Release 1.2.0: Theme Editor & Component Mixer, GTK and GNOME Shell color customization, persistent theme forks, session draft auto-save and recovery, and adaptive wallpaper color palette extraction.

Release 1.1.0: Global Themes unified view, structural Theme Validator, corruption detection and pre-apply warnings, in-app and desktop live previews with auto-rollback, icon pack preview grid, automated user directory creation, and assisted theme installer.
Release 1.0.0: GTK4/Libadwaita GUI, Preset 2.0, Shell themes and user-theme extension management, unified modals, AppStream packaging and translations.
